'''Gardulla the Hutt's Palace''', also known as the '''Palace of Gardulla the Hutt''' or '''Bou'Halec''', was a palace owned by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and used for the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt, Gardulla employed many Nikto guards, as well as guards of other species. When [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress's]] [[Death Watch/Legends|forces]] attacked the palace, the many guards stationed at the time failed to prevent the attack, and most were killed. The palace itself contained the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|Hutt Council Chamber]], a large dance hall, many holding cells, and so on. One of these cells was used to hold [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] when he was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] (he eventually broke free and escaped from the planet with help from [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], who later killed him). This citadel was well-guarded by many [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]].
